result.stdout:
Usage: iconpackbuilder [options] [project.ipproj]
       iconpackbuilder export <project.ipproj>

Opens the Singulink Icon Pack Builder, optionally loading the given project file. The export command writes the project's
export folder without opening the editor (for scripts and CI) and exits with a non-zero code if the export fails.

Options:
  --wait                          Keep the console attached until the app exits and forward its exit code.
  --register-file-association     Open .ipproj files with Icon Pack Builder (current user; Windows and Linux).
  --unregister-file-association   Remove the .ipproj association added by --register-file-association.
  -h, --help                      Show this help.
